Name: Kenneth's Lore Letters
Author: Kf29
Description:
[size=4][b]Ever wonder what the townspeople are really thinking when you're not around?[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Kenneth's Lore Letters gives you one small story every morning for a full year. Letters from Lewis about the town's history, Gunther about artifacts, Wizard about Junimos, Linus about living in nature, Robin about your farmhouse.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]It is not a wiki mod. It is world-building. Makes Pelican Town feel like it existed before you and will exist after.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]What you get:[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- 112 Unique Mails - Letters from different villagers.[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Real Lore - Community Center built in 1923, Dwarf language, Junimos, Legendary fish tips, Skull Cavern secrets.[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Helpful hints hidden in stories - Where to find Crimsonfish, how seed makers work, what gifts people like.[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Immersive - Feels like you found old letters in your mailbox.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Example: "Letter from Lewis: That old community center... built in 1923 by my grandfather. The Junimos used to protect it, they say."[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]For players who love Stardew for its story, not just its farming.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Made by Kf.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Compatibility - Can I install all your mail mods together?[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Yes! You can install all of them at the same time, no problem.[/b][/size]

[b][size=4]- All my mail mods are separate, so they work together.[/size][/b]
[size=4][b]- Want only one vibe? Install just one.[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Want a full mailbox every morning? Install them all - you'll get Birthday + Helper + Inspirational + Lore etc. in one day.[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- No conflicts, no overwrites, lightweight Content Patcher only.[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Works with Vanilla and Expanded, any farm, any save.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]All mail mods by Kf:[/b][/size]
[b][size=4]- Kenneth's Birthday & Gift Guide[/size][/b]
[b][size=4]- Kenneth's Daily Helper - Useful Mail Every Day[/size][/b]
[size=4][b]- Kenneth's Inspirational Mails[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Kenneth's Motivational Mails[/b][/size]
